svg.title: Azure Policy and a lock in a sandbox resource group
svg.desc: Two policy assignments apply only to the sandbox resource group rg-azb-sandbox. Allowed locations first audits, then denies a storage account in the wrong region with RequestDisallowedByPolicy. Require a tag, first with enforcement disabled and then enabled, refuses a storage account without the env tag. A storage account in the right region with the tag is created. A CanNotDelete lock on it blocks its delete. The clean up order is: 1 remove the lock, 2 delete the policy assignments, 3 delete the resource group.
svg.text: Assign policies here only, never on the subscription
